title: Double-helix structure of DNA
summary: Watson and Crick published the double-helix model in Nature, built using X-ray data including Rosalind Franklin and Raymond Gosling's 'Photo 51'. Watson, Crick and Maurice Wilkins shared the 1962 Nobel.
why: Showed how DNA copies itself and stores information.

unsung.contribution: Her X-ray work, including Photo 51 taken by her student Raymond Gosling, revealed DNA's structure.
unsung.recognition: Wilkins showed Photo 51 to Watson without her permission; her contributions were largely unrecognised in her life.
